rv.q: Under the direction of Jim Corti and Landree Fleming, this cast presents an unforgettable evening of theater.
This is simply the best Fun Home I have ever seen, and it goes away all too soon, so make the trip; you'll thank me.
Fun Home is easily one of my favorite musicals written in this century.
Ultimately it is this sense of optimism that lifts the entire production.

cn.t: Critics praise this production of the Tony-winning musical as brilliant and poignant, with nuanced performances elevating Alison Bechdel's memoir about discovering her sexuality while uncovering her father's closeted life.
